ocean-acidification.def: The decrease in the pH of seawater as it absorbs carbon dioxide from the air. Surface ocean pH has fallen from about 8.2 to about 8.1 since the 1700s.

carbonic-acid.def: Carbonic acid (H₂CO₃) forms when CO₂ dissolves in water and releases hydrogen ions. Those ions bind carbonate ions (CO₃²⁻), leaving less for organisms to build calcium carbonate (CaCO₃) shells and skeletons.
